page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with two marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines "Ac pto-" and "scribunt". Below the last line: a signature at the left and a catchword at the right.

main_text.p: in fide, fortitudine animi in perferendis pro Christo omne genus tormentis, charitate in fratres[?], mortificatione carnis, honestate vitæ, contemtu Mundi, denique sanctificatione, & Christianis Apostolicisq; moribus. Ecclesiæ erant recens ab Apostolis plantatæ, in purissima doctrina, & seueta[?] disciplina instituta, à nemine adhuc adulteratæ, à nemine vitiatæ, ceu castissimæ & incontaminatæ virgines, in quarum ore recens adhuc lac Apostolicum hærebat, suauissimeque olebat. Atque in primis, ut dixi, Romana, quemadmodum Patres omnes illi vetustissimi testificantur: cui nihil vel ab ipsis hæreticis obiici poterat merito. Ergo ad hanc, & huius similes Ecclesias, tanquam ad illas, apud quas purissima manebat doctrina, provocabant Patres, & volebant eas esse controuersiarum iudi-ces, urgebántque illarum autoritatem, & contendebant, cum iis, qui harum reiicerent autoritatem, non esse amplius è scripturis disputandum. Sed quæ dissimilitudo est inter illam & hanc? Quæ inter castam virginem, & impudentissimum scortum. Ac pto-Romanainde quæ etiam est impudentia, quæ Patres Ecclesia.scribunt de illa sanctissima & castissima virgine, ea retorquere ad hoc putidissimum, impudicissimum, & impudentissimum scortum? ad præsentem scilicet Romanam Babylonem? quæ nihil vel parum retinet amplius Apostolicæ vel doctrinæ, vel pietatis, vel disciplinæ: sed in qua diabolus regnat, in

page.notes: The two right-margin notes are "Romana" and "Ecclesia.", both in italics, set as running marginal headings. The reference "pto-" in "Ac pto-" is read as printed; the expected form is "pro-", so it may be a printing error or a damaged letter. "feueta" is read as "seueta" with a doubtful letter. "f.atres" has an ink mark where the letter should be, read as "fratres" with a doubtful letter. The signature "T ʃ" is read as "T 5" with a doubtful final mark. The page opens mid-paragraph, so it is marked cont="true".
